messages:
Chris W.: Quick checkpoint on the quarterly milestone for the ownership-limiter feature. Shipped: limiter core + unit tests -> staging. Slipped: canary rollout bumped to next week due to infra creds rotation. Need owners for rollback/runbook + CRs on limiter-service PR (#512).

Maria P.: Got it. Link the PR? I can take the CR if Jin's tied up.

Jin L.: PR: https://git.redwood/infra/limiter-service/pull/512. I'm on infra deps — kubeconfig rotation is blocking canary. Seeing e2e fail with auth error: 
```
E 11:03:21 auth: failed to fetch token: permission denied (403)
at auth.getToken (auth.js:82)
```
Pinged eng-infra.

Alex K.: I'll pick up the front-end integration CR (#518) and do an initial pass today. @Sarah B. can you confirm telemetry events are still mapped to limiter.v1?

Sarah B.: On telemetry. I'll run a smoke and validate events, can check Thu morning.

Eli (PM): Priority note: we need canary up by Fri to keep K1 OKR. If it slips past Fri, we should agree to de-scope auto-scaling for this quarter and roll that to roadmap. Also we need a clear rollback owner.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: build 512 passed -> staging at 3921234572 :rocket:

Chris W.: Action items (TL;DR):
- Maria: CR for #512 (limiter-service)
- Alex: CR for #518 (frontend)
- Jin: follow up with eng-infra about kubeconfig rotation
- Sarah: telemetry smoke by Thu
- Eli: update OKR doc if we miss Fri
I'll draft a short rollback runbook in this thread in 30m.

Maria P.: :thumbsup: Taking #512, aiming to finish by 4pm PT.

Jin L.: Eng-infra replied, rotation scheduled for 11am PST tomorrow. They said tests will need kubeconfig v2. I'll post the minimal kubeconfig diff once they confirm.

Sarah B.: Telemetry smoke scheduled Thu 10:00am PT, I'll post results and sample events here.

Chris W.: Rollback command for ops if needed:
```
./bin/rollout-rollback --service limiter-service --to-tag v2.3.1
```
If someone performs rollback, pls also run: `./scripts/clear-kv-cache --service limiter-service` afterwards.

Eli (PM): Thanks — I'll hold exec update until canary status. If we hit Fri delay, I'll file de-scope and owners for auto-scaling.

Alex K.: Noted. Will post CR comments by EOD.

Chris W.: Perfect. I'll update the milestone checklist and ping infra if we don't see kubeconfig by 11:30am tomorrow.

(edited)
